description: Fetch the live perception feed twice with a short delay, then return both raw payloads plus a hash-based freshness check. Use this as a demo proof bundle when you need to show the feed is not placeholder data.

limit.description: Max number of perception events to fetch on each probe (1-10, default 3).

modality.description: Optional sensory modality to constrain the verification probe.

wait_ms.description: Delay between the two probes in milliseconds (default 2000).

name: afferens_verify
